view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall metal shelving units holding boxes and crates. A large beige air filter unit sits on a pallet in the center. In the background, there's an open doorway, blue trash bins, and more stacked materials. The space is utilitarian with concrete floors and industrial lighting.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall gray metal shelving unit on left, partially obstructing view. Holds wooden crates and red plastic bins. Red vertical label with white text visible. Supports stacked items above ground level. Contacts floor at base. Occluded by foreground elements.

objects.label: beige air filter unit
objects.observation: Large rectangular beige air filter unit with grid pattern, resting on a wooden pallet. Positioned centrally in aisle. Appears freestanding. Contacts floor via pallet. No visible supports or mounting hardware. Occluded slightly by shelving to left.

objects.label: blue trash bin
objects.observation: Blue plastic trash bin located near doorway in background. Positioned on concrete floor. Appears freestanding. Contacts floor. Partially occluded by doorway frame. No visible supports or mounting.

objects.label: wooden crates
objects.observation: Stacked wooden crates on top shelf of shelving unit. Brown color, secured with metal straps. Located high up, behind shelving. Contacts shelf surface. Occluded by upper shelf edge and shelving structure.

objects.label: red plastic bins
objects.observation: Red plastic storage bins on lower shelves. Multiple bins visible, some partially obscured. Rest on shelf surface. Contacts shelf. Occluded by other bins and shelving structure.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: Open doorway in background wall, revealing another area. Has yellow curtain partially visible inside. Frame appears metallic. Contacts wall. Occluded by surrounding warehouse structures.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Cardboard boxes stacked on pallets in right background. Brown color, some with green labels. Rest on wooden pallets. Contacts floor. Occluded by warehouse pillars and distance.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33127", "image_size": [640, 480], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
